posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
your YEP pluins arent in the correct order.
ScreenResolution could be OFF while its in YEP_EngineCore.
PXD_Lockpick does have some serious issues as I made an overhaul
to fix all the bugs and glitches inside of it.
most of the settings are the same (check the data from it what you can do)
as there are also some new features added.
also in SRD_MapSlipDamage is a small bug of flashing (easy fix) but don't
know what line, but it was missing * in the code after the "\s" which should be "\s*".
so re-order YEP plugins and best in category so the compability is far less.
